variables.name: base/450
variables.description:
Base neutral, ladder step 450 of 950  |  content - text, icons, borders
Cool  -> cool/450  #6C7D94  tone 52  vs white 4.20:1
Warm  -> warm/450  #8F7861  tone 52  vs white 4.18:1
The name is the step: base/450 always resolves to step 450 of the active theme ramp.
Pairing rule - +400 = 3:1 non-text, +500 = AA 4.5:1, +700 = AAA 7:1. Holds in both themes.
